description: SS 469(i) special allowance with the AGI phase-out: single, AGI 120,000 (wages), no passive income, 30,000 of active-participation rental losses. Allowance cap = 25,000 - 50% x (120,000 - 100,000) = 15,000; allowed = min(30,000, 15,000) = 15,000; suspended = 15,000. Hand-computed from SS 469(i)(2)-(3) verbatim.
